Q3 HIGHLIGHT 
Bangkok Lab and Cosmetic Public Company Limited (BLC) has been awarded an
"Excellent" (5-star) rating in the Corporate Governance Report of Thai Listed Companies
2025 (CGR) by the Thai Institute of Directors (IOD), reflecting its unwavering commitment
to good corporate governance, transparency, accountability, and equitable consideration
of all stakeholders to achieve strong and sustainable growth. This achievement motivates
BLC to continuously develop its operational processes to meet international standards,
maintain its excellence in corporate governance, and remain dedicated to creating high-
quality pharmaceutical and comprehensive healthcare products.
On August 26, 2025, Bangkok Lab and Cosmetic Public Company Limited (BLC) received
a certificate for the "ESG DNA Program for Corporate Employees" from the Stock
Exchange of Thailand (SET). This achievement underscores BLC's dedication to promoting
and instilling knowledge of ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) among its
personnel, evidenced by over 70% of its employees participating in and completing the
basic sustainability training in 2024, successfully meeting its target. This reflects BLC's
commitment to using ESG principles as a crucial foundation for driving the organization
toward stable and sustainable growth.

On the occasion of World Diabetes Day, BLC successfully hosted a
major event in collaboration with Health Up to reinforce DiabeDerm
as a specialized skincare product for patients with diabetes and
kidney disease.
We achieved maximum credibility through a presentation delivered
by a specialist physician in diabetes and kidney disease, and
boosted Brand Engagement with the presence of our presenter, Khun
Aom Piyada Akarasenee. The event also featured an exhibition booth
dedicated to educating attendees about the DiabeDerm product.
The excellent feedback confirms the achievement of both our
academic goals and the strong increase in Brand Awareness.

From an early factory dedicated to the production
of generic drugs, the Company has continued
developing its manufacturing capabilities, enabling
the factory to produce a broad spectrum of health
products including modern medicines, generic and
new generic drugs, herbal medicine, cosmetics,
dietary supplements among many other things.Production Line
The company has established the BLC Research Center to foster innovation
and technological development for its products, aiming for stable business
growth. This center facilitates the commercialization of research by
collaborating with various Thai state and private research agencies and
universities. A key focus is integrating traditional Thai knowledge with
scientific research and modern technology to develop herbal products,
thereby increasing competitiveness and ensuring sustainable business
expansion.
Laboratories
Laboratories have played a key role in controlling the quality of products
and the continued success of Bangkok Lab & Cosmetic Public Company
Limited since its founding.
The Company has stressed the importance of designing each laboratory to
enable the convenient and safe performance of functions and minimize
environmental impacts. The labs also provide controlled conditions
appropriate for each testing condition to ensure precision and reliability.Food supplement

NET PROFIT AND NET PROFIT MARGIN
Unit: Million Baht, %
Q3/25 Net Profit Performance
Net profit for Q3 2025 was 40.2 million Baht, with a net profit margin of 10.0%.
Margin declined from 10.9% (3Q2024) primarily due to higher
branding/advertising expenses and lower interest income from short-term
investments (as funds were used for a new production building and
machinery).
Margin slightly improved from 9.9% (Q2 2025) due to an 8.6% drop in selling
expenses, as the one-time presenter launch cost occurred in the previous
quarter.9M/25 Net Profit Performance
Net profit for 9M 2025 was 137.1 million Baht; the net margin
slightly increased to 10.9% (from 10.7% in 2024).
The profit increase was driven by revenue growth (from
marketing/branding strategies) and a significant reduction in
finance costs (due to loan repayment).
The result was partially offset by higher income tax expense, raising
the effective tax rate to 21.0%, due to increased non-deductible
entertainment expenses.
